alerts.headline: Q2 results impact: Rentomojo shares jump up to 10% as profit surges 125% QoQ to Rs 18 crore

alerts.headline: Bajaj Finance may launch Rs 11,700-crore QIP to fund growth; shares trade higher
alerts.summary: Bajaj Finance may launch a Rs 11,700-crore QIP at a small discount to the market price to fund growth, according to CNBC-TV18. The proposed share sale follows the allotment of Rs 5,800-crore warrants to Bajaj Finserv.

alerts.headline: Netweb, E2E Networks, other AI-related stocks rise up to 9% as Anthropic IPO, CoreWeave earnings lift global AI sentiment
alerts.summary: Futures for the Nasdaq 100 jumped 1.3%, recouping the underlying index’s loss in regular trading, thanks to better-than-expected earnings from AI computing provider CoreWeave Inc

alerts.headline: Three forces behind November's market turnaround: AI correction, Rs 54,000-crore FII comeback and earnings resilience
alerts.summary: A crack in the crowded AI trade has triggered a global portfolio rethink, sending foreign money back to India. Improving corporate earnings, moderating valuations and easing macroeconomic concerns are giving the rally fundamental support.
